tool_plan.objective: Generate and preserve representative Chromium browser-cache entries for ChromeCacheView to read, inspect, export, or extract.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Initialize Chromium-compatible browser profiles that can generate persistent cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Load distinct documents and network resources into the browser cache.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observe available controls before exercising visible page behavior.

required_actions.name: browser.click
required_actions.why: Exercise observed links or controls that request additional cacheable resources.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Submit realistic search or form input that can produce parameterized cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Change observed finite page parameters that may request materially different content.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveal lazy-loaded content and associated cacheable resources.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserve a visible representation of the browsed content associated with cache generation.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Close browser sessions so pending cache writes can be flushed to their profiles.

completion.detail: Complete only after cache data is present in both the Chromium and Edge browser-profile cache locations following browser closure.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch a Chromium-compatible browser profile and use run-provided runtime targets with browser.goto to load a few varied, content-rich pages that naturally request documents, images, scripts, styles, and other cacheable resources. On each page, use browser.get_clickables before interaction; use browser.click only on observed visible controls or links likely to load additional content. Where visible search or form fields are available, use browser.smart_type to submit realistic input; where visible finite choices are available, use browser.select_option to request a different page variant. Use browser.scroll to reveal lazy-loaded visible content, then re-observe with browser.get_clickables before any further bounded interaction. Capture browser.screenshot for representative loaded states. Repeat the same artifact-generating flow in an Edge profile so both chromium.cache.cache_data and edge.cache.cache_data are created, then use browser.close for each session to flush cache writes. Reason guidance: record context-specific reasons describing the current page and cache effect, such as loading a resource-heavy page, following an observed content link, revealing lazy-loaded
